headline: Gambia Allocates One-Third of National Budget to Debt Servicing
summary: Gambian lawmakers passed a D48.6 billion budget where debt service consumes a third of total outlays, outranking education and health combined.
why: High debt-service burdens constrain fiscal space for public capital investments and social spending in developing economies.

impacts.name: Gambia
impacts.why: Heavy debt service obligations limit government spending flexibility and elevate fiscal vulnerability.
